commit.message:
feat: release a persistent distribution cache on release tag creation (#50112)

This adds a new release-cutting GitHub action, which automatically tags a release in response to new tag being pushed -- e.g. `lyrical/2026-10-05`. It regenerates the distribution cache tarball for the release, and then pushes this cache to a release artifact, allowing developers to recreate source workspaces for specific releases. We can also manually trigger this workflow on previous releases to back-fill our release page.
